instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for ReferralMoss Intake Passage: The objective is to register incoming care referrals, record service eligibility, and communicate whether each referral is accepted for assessment or returned. Referring Clinic Clerks submit referrals with patient-reference, requested-service, and referring-clinician information. Referral Intake Officers record receipt and check mandatory fields. Service Eligibility Clerks record whether requested services are handled by the receiving clinic. Referral Coordinators record acceptance or return outcomes and return reasons. Correspondence Clerks send recorded outcomes and close intake after dispatch. Clinical diagnosis and appointment scheduling are excluded.

output.business_objective: Register incoming care referrals, record service eligibility, and communicate whether each referral is accepted for assessment or returned.

Clinical diagnosis and appointment scheduling are outside scope.
